input.rationale: This is clearly an auto collision claim: a motor vehicle was struck and totaled, causing both vehicle damage and bodily injury to the policyholder.

Totaled vehicle (well above $25,000 threshold) combined with bodily injury (whiplash and sprained wrist) requires immediate adjuster attention; whiplash carries a risk of symptom escalation and requires medical documentation.

input.claim_summary: Pat Morgan was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 by a vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking, resulting in a totaled vehicle with the trunk crushed into the back seat. The policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist; a police report was filed with the other driver's insurance information included.
